title: Add compact JSON mode, list date filters, and batch retag helpers

sections.what: Support optional storage.compact_json serialization omitting empty lists/strings, add --created-after/--updated-after filters on list, and add batch tag rename/alias migration.
sections.why: Explicit empty fields aid uniform readability while compact mode cuts token footprint on large repos, and date/tag batch tools help curate backlogs cleanly.
sections.how: Read storage.compact_json in models.py and schema.py, add date bounds in service.list_tasks and cli.py, and add a retag service/CLI command.
sections.verify: Run unit tests covering compact round-trip, date filtering, and batch tag normalization.

acceptance.text: compact_json omits empty optional values while reloading cleanly into full TaskRecord
retag updates matching tags across JSON tasks cleanly

evidence: Added storage.compact_json support in ProjectContext, TaskRecord.to_json_dict(compact=...), and store.py write_new_task/save_task.
Added created_after/updated_after date filters to service.list_tasks, cli.py (--created-after/--updated-after), and mcp_server.py.
Added service.retag_tasks and `taskweave retag` CLI command for batch tag renaming and alias normalization.
